backend: CPU particle solver, standard sand under fixed 1 g; no rendering or worker transport
model: coarse fine-sand volume samples + PBD Coulomb friction + adaptive translation/sleep islands + ambient Stokes and local Darcy-inspired resistance; no gas pressure/velocity solver

sampling.crossings: Each grain counts once when first observed below y=0; times are upper sample bounds, quantized to at most one simulated second. Crossings that return above y=0 between samples are not observed.
sampling.stability: Full particle scans at t=0, each simulated second, and the final step; not every step
sampling.pile: Linear fit of radial top-surface bins for lower grains moving at <=0.03 m/s; excludes floor-touching grains, central bin, outer bin and bins with <3 grains. Positive angle means height decreases outward; null means insufficient data. This measurement alone does not establish a stable cone.

results.statusReason: Every grain is below y=0 at the final sample
results.openingWarning: Geometric clearance does not rule out frictional arching
